title: AI transforms work environment and worker well-being
discussion_signal: The public discussion connects changing work organization with population-level mental and social well-being, highlighting surveillance, autonomy, data-driven management, and psychosocial conditions rather than treating well-being as an individual issue alone.
linked_research_question: How does changing work organization turn psychosocial well-being into a population-health, productivity, and governance question?
limits: The post interprets an ILO working paper and is not representative worker evidence
It does not estimate prevalence or causal effects
The public discussion foregrounds risks and gives limited attention to beneficial workplace uses
